predicate_and_helpers.basis: Read FoodPacking2BoxesTask terminations: success = object_in_container(object=['cheez_it', 'sugar_box'], container='bin_a06', logical='all', require_gripper_detached=True), and the helpers in conditionals.py and predicate_logic.py; RobolabEnv records success as the TerminationManager's terminated flag, the OR of every non-timeout term.

reset_and_randomization.basis: Scene foodpacking_1bin_2box_2can.usda: cheez_it, sugar_box, bin_a06 among 7 contact objects. The env's only event is reset_scene_to_default and the task adds none, so every seed resets to the same authored layout; a seed varies physics only.

assets_and_frames.basis: Containment tests the centroid of the object's convex hull in the container's local frame against the container hull with its top faces removed (hull_check), so a tipped container fails and the region above the open top counts.

success_timing.basis: DoneTerm success is evaluated every control step; RobolabEnv freezes the env at the first true step (a termination within its first two steps is reset as a physics artifact) and the ORA session latches it.
